name: ui-walkthrough
about: A product walkthrough of 25-40 s: a promise, the user's input as one object that becomes the output in place, proof piling up, a speed claim, then the product's own flow in steps (the input goes in, the product reads every item, finds what matters, the user picks, it builds), the output live and the end card. new-film.sh --template ui-walkthrough lays these files over the Remotion starter.

music.about: Every walkthrough is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): the track carries the film and earshot effects mark the product's state changes; never effects only.
music.pick: find this film's own track: node scripts/music.mjs search --mood "<the film's mood words>" --bpm 110-128 --length <s>, then music.mjs sheet --measure and music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track); 110-128 BPM with a clear kick suits the template's whole-bar acts
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --template ui-walkthrough --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py edit --bars N --reveal-bar K --end stop|button|ring
